US AI Data Center Land Purchases Reach $6 Billion Amid Power Access Premiums

US investment in land for AI data centers has reached $6 billion, with access to power being a significant factor driving up prices. Tata Power has identified a pipeline of 2.8 gigawatts (GW) of data center opportunities across 18 players, fueled by the artificial intelligence boom.
